connector.name: Fldigi MCP
connector.registryDescription: Control fldigi (amateur-radio digital modes) over XML-RPC: modem, frequency, rig, log, transmit.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package fldigi-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sbrunner-atx account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: FLDIGI_CALLSIGN
env.description: Operator callsign. Required to enable transmit; leave blank to stay receive-only.

env.name: FLDIGI_REGION
env.description: IARU region for band guidance: 1, 2, or 3.
